messages:
Ava: Quick heads-up — I'm gating the catalog PR until we confirm the perf profile for ozark9b. 95th latency on long prompts spiked in staging.
Raj: Which test run? Any artifacts we can look at?
Ava: Run id `stg-ozark-2026-03-15-12`. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/ozark/1234. 95th went from ~220ms -> ~680ms at ~2k tokens.
Marta: That pattern usually means KV cache didn't warm. Did you run with `cache_policy: full_prefix`?
Ava: Nope, default policy. I re-ran with prefix cache and 95th dropped to ~260ms. So config difference.
Diego: Ok — can we add the cache recommendation to the model manifest so future runs don't regress? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/842
Ava: Tagging @Marta for the manifest change. Also legal needs the final license blurb for ozark — @Sam-legal any ETA?
Sam-legal: I can draft the blurb by EOD tomorrow. Need confirmation whether the upstream includes any non-commercial clauses.
Marta: I'll open a tiny PR to update `manifest.yaml` and add `perf_profile: ozark-stability-v1` with a note about `cache_policy`. Will include the relevant perf numbers.
Raj: One more infra note: on Dedicated the tokenization step added ~40ms for this model in telemetry — @infra-sre can you check the tokeniser image/version in staging?
infra-sre: Saw the spike in metrics. Rolling a hotfix to the tokeniser image in staging now; will post rollout status.
Ava: Actions: (1) Marta -> PR manifest, (2) Sam-legal -> final license text, (3) infra-sre -> tokeniser fix and staging smoke, (4) me -> re-run canary after manifest merge. If canary looks good I'll remove the "gate" label.
Marta: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/850 — reviewers @Raj @Ava
Raj: Reviewing now, left a small nit in the docs section.
Ava: Thanks. If anyone's blocked on the gating label ping me directly, otherwise I'll proceed async. :thumbsup:
